items.raw_excerpt: An international start-up wanting to carry out controversial carbon storage research in New Zealand waters has had its request for regulation changes turned down.
items.summary_en: A start-up called Gigablue wanted to test carbon storage in New Zealand waters. The company asked the government to change the law so it could go ahead. The request was turned down.

items.title_en: Start-up denied permission for marine carbon storage trial

items.raw_excerpt: A Swedish settlement on the Mississippi, a Frank Lloyd Wright estate, and Wisconsin's only free ferry. Six river towns worth a slow visit.
items.summary_en: A travel list features six small river towns along the Mississippi in Wisconsin. The guide covers a Swedish settlement, a Frank Lloyd Wright house, and the state's only free ferry. These quiet towns are good for a slow visit.

items.summary_en: A concert took place in the Benimaclet neighborhood of Valencia. The group Blue Caravan played on the street near the Glop. Musicians Juan and Cristobal Belda said Valencia is too small a city for music.

items.raw_excerpt: The rate at which babies are being born before arriving at hospital has doubled in regional areas since 2001, in outer regional and remote areas it has more than tripled.
items.summary_en: In regional parts of New South Wales, more babies are being born before they reach a hospital. The rate has doubled since 2001, and in far rural areas it has more than tripled. Small country hospitals say they now care for mothers and babies on roads far from any big hospital.
items.summary_ko: 호주 뉴사우스웨일스주 농촌 지역에서 병원에 도착하기 전에 아이를 낳는 경우가 늘고 있습니다. 2001년 이후 비율이 두 배가 됐고, 외곽 농촌 지역에서는 세 배 넘게 증가했습니다. 작은 지역 병원은 큰 병원에서 아주 먼 길 위에서 산모와 아기를 돌보고 있다고 말했습니다.
items.title_en: More babies are born on the road in regional NSW
items.title_ko: 호주 뉴사우스웨일스 농촌, 이동 중 출산 증가
items.title_original: Birthing among 'flies and trucks' becoming more common in parts of NSW

items.raw_excerpt: When FPT chairman Truong Gia Binh proposed opening a school to raise and educate children orphaned by Covid-19, many people expressed doubt and also opposition.
items.summary_en: FPT chairman Truong Gia Binh opened a school for children who lost their parents to Covid-19. Many people doubted the plan and argued against it. He says the school will raise and teach the children himself.
items.summary_ko: FPT 회장 트루웅 지아 빈은 코로나로 부모를 잃은 아이들을 위한 학교를 열었다. 많은 사람들이 이 계획에 의문을 품고 반대했다. 그는 그 학교에서 아이들을 직접 키우고 가르치겠다고 말했다.
items.title_en: A Tech Boss Opens a School for Children Left by Covid

items.title_original: FPT chief's 'gamble' for Covid orphans

items.summary_en: Chef Johanne Siy opens her first restaurant, Aro, on Mohamed Sultan Road on Sep 25. The menu shows off ingredients that are often overlooked, like Filipino seaweed, pili nuts and artisanal salt.

items.raw_excerpt: More than 22,000 taxis were converted to electric vehicles, making this city the first in the world with an all-electric taxi fleet.
items.summary_en: Hanoi turned more than 22,000 taxis into electric vehicles. It is now the first city in the world whose taxi fleet uses no gasoline at all.

items.raw_excerpt: Los nacionales terminaron una positiva campaña en Santa Fe.
items.summary_en: Chile's weightlifting team, known as the Condors, won a silver medal at the South American Games. The final against Argentina was a close fight that came down to the last round. The games were held in Santa Fe, Argentina.
items.summary_ko: 칠레 역도팀은 남미 경기회에서 은메달을 획득했습니다. 아르헨티나와 맞붙은 결승은 마지막 판까지 접전이었습니다. 대회는 아르헨티나 산타페에서 열렸습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: How does it work and how long does it last? Here’s what to know.
items.summary_en: Scalp micropigmentation uses tiny dots of color to make thinning hair look fuller. It can work fast, but the effect may fade and need repeats. Experts say it is not a real cure for hair loss.
items.summary_ko: 두피 마이크로필라멘테이션은 피부에 작은 점으로 색을 찍어 얇아진 머리를 풍성해 보이게 하는 시술이다. 효과가 빨리 나타나지만 색이 옅어져 다시 시술해야 할 수 있다. experts는 진짜 탈모 치료법은 아니라고 말한다.
items.title_en: Scalp micropigmentation: a quick fix for thin hair?

items.raw_excerpt: Digital Goa, Sept 21 – The Goa government has proposed uniform trade licence and permission fees for village panchayats, with separate ceilings for commercially prominent Category ‘A’ areas and other Category ‘B’ areas. Panchayats will fix rates through resolutions within the prescribed limits. The draft rules cover various businesses, including shops, hotels, casinos, beach shacks, […]
items.summary_en: The Goa government has proposed a single trade licence fee rule for village panchayats, with two rate bands for busy areas and other areas. Panchayats can set their own fees inside the new limits for shops, hotels, casinos and beach shacks, and people can send feedback within 15 days.
items.summary_ko: 고아주정부는 마을 자치회 상점 수수료 기준을 서로 나누지 않고 하나로 묶는안을 냈다. 상점과 호텔, 카지노, 해변 가게까지 같은 규정을 쓰며 15일 동안 의견을 받는다.
items.title_en: Goa sets one fee rule for village shops

items.summary_en: Chile's under-20 women's team is in the gold medal match at the South American Games. Coach Luis Mena's squad had a perfect run to reach the final.

items.summary_en: Harvey Norman in Singapore started selling the HP Omnibook Ultra in a deep espresso brown color. It costs S$3,399 and comes with gifts worth S$728. Only a few pieces are left, so stock is limited.

items.raw_excerpt: Diamonds goalkeeper Sarah Klau is named in Australia's squad for the Constellation Cup, despite being sanctioned by the sport's national governing body.
items.summary_en: Australia's netball team, the Diamonds, has named goalkeeper Sarah Klau in its squad for the Constellation Cup. Klau is still serving a sanction from Netball Australia. The cup is played in New Zealand. The team hopes Klau can play, even with the sanction in place.
items.summary_ko: 호주 네트볼 대표팀 다이아몬즈가 별자리 컵 참가 명단에 골키퍼 사라 클라우를 넣었다. 클라우는 호주 네트볼 협회의 제재를 아직 받고 있다. 대회는 뉴질랜드에서 열린다. 팀은 제재가 있어도 클라우가 경기할 수 있기를 기대한다.
items.title_en: Diamonds name sanctioned goalkeeper Klau for the Constellation Cup

items.raw_excerpt: In an Instagram post on Sunday (Sep 20), Singaporean rapper-businessman Sheikh Haikel uploaded a picture of the cast members of the popular 1996 film Army Daze reuniting at his chicken rice shop.
items.summary_en: Cast members of the 1996 Singapore film Army Daze met again at singer Sheikh Haikel's chicken rice shop. He shared a photo of the group reunion on Instagram on Sunday, Sep 20. The old friends had a casual get-together over lunch at his eatery.
items.summary_ko: 1996년 싱가포르 영화 《악리 데이즈》 출연진이 싱가포르 래퍼 셰이크 하이켈의 치킨라이스 집에서 다시 모였습니다. 하이켈은 9월 20일 일요일 인스타그램에 단체 재회 사진을 올렸습니다. 오랜 친구들은 그가 운영하는 식당에서 점심을 함께하며 반가운 시간을 보냈습니다.
items.title_en: Army Daze cast reunites at a chicken rice shop

items.raw_excerpt: A native vegetation ruling grounds a South Australian rocket launch complex despite having state and federal government planning approval.
items.summary_en: A conservation group has blocked a rocket launch site in South Australia. The group won a court ruling about native plants that grow on the land. State and federal governments had already approved the project.

items.raw_excerpt: The Singapore baby-care brand said Tollyjoy products are no longer being sold in Singapore, although some remain available in Malaysia.
items.summary_en: Tollyjoy, a baby-care brand, says it is no longer selling its products in Singapore. The company started in 1970 and says it decided to close for reasons other than money. Some of its products are still sold in Malaysia.
items.summary_ko: 유아용품 브랜드 톨리조이가 싱가포르에서 제품 판매를 중단한다고 밝혔다. 이 회사는 1970년에 문을 연 곳으로, 돈 때문이 아닌 다른 이유로 폐업을 결정했다고 설명했다. 일부 제품은 아직 말레이시아에서 판매되고 있다.
items.title_en: Baby brand Tollyjoy stops selling in Singapore after 55 years

items.summary_en: The Living Exhibition opened in Ho Chi Minh City on Sept. 21. It shows more than 25 projects by over 75 artists, photographers and designers from Vietnam and 20 other countries.
